decks.notes: This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with low-cost, aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to deal damage quickly and efficiently, using cards like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge to remove threats while continuing to push for damage. The inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Static Prison can disrupt the opponent's mana base and game plan, giving the Boros player a strategic advantage. With Jegantha as a companion, the deck gains access to additional mana and flexibility, allowing for even more aggressive plays.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on efficiency and aggression, utilizing a mix of powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Amped Raptor along with burn spells like Lightning Bolt to quickly pressure the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Blood Moon and Static Prison to control the board and prevent the opponent from gaining an advantage. With a streamlined mana base and a strong curve, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early in the game and maintain pressure throughout.

The deck focuses on using Underworld Breach along with spell untapping effects and ramp to generate infinite mana, cast Wish multiple times, and ultimately win with a game-winning spell like Consign to Memory. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and efficiently while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Sink into Stupor. The deck can also tutor for key pieces using Expedition Map and Tolaria West. Lotus Field and Deserted Temple are used to help generate the mana needed to execute the combo efficiently.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays using low-cost creatures and efficient removal spells to pressure the opponent quickly. It also utilizes graveyard synergies with cards like Cling to Dust and Necrodominance to provide additional value and resilience. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek while presenting a fast clock with creatures like Grief and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy while allowing for flexible casting of spells.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures with haste and powerful instant spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It also includes cards like Blood Moon and Static Prison to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional value and flexibility. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and maintain control of the board with efficient removal spells and disruptive effects. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, allowing for quick deployment of threats and disruption.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The key strategy is to constantly apply pressure on the opponent with powerful creatures like Grief and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, while disrupting their plans with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The deck also has ways to reuse creatures from the graveyard with cards like Necrodominance and Malakir Rebirth. Overall, the goal is to maintain a relentless offense while controlling the board to secure a quick victory.

The main concept of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt and control your opponent's resources while gradually building up your own advantage through powerful removal spells and card advantage. The deck includes cards that can efficiently remove threats from the board, as well as cards that allow you to reanimate creatures or gain card advantage. By carefully managing your resources and making strategic plays, you can outvalue your opponent and ultimately dominate the game through sheer control and attrition.

The key concept of this deck is to control the opponent's resources and board state through a combination of powerful Eldrazi creatures and versatile spells. The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands to generate a large amount of mana, allowing for efficient casting of powerful threats like Thought-Knot Seer and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. Karn, the Great Creator is used to disrupt the opponent's artifacts and further establish control, while cards like All Is Dust provide board wipe options. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its powerful creatures and disruption spells.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and targeted burn spells. With a mix of efficient creatures like Amped Raptor and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, along with powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge, the deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to zero. Additionally, cards like Blood Moon and Static Prison help disrupt the opponent's mana base and control strategies, allowing the deck to maintain its aggressive pressure and secure a fast victory.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on utilizing efficient creatures and removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes ways to sacrifice creatures for additional value and to trigger abilities. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides an additional card advantage and mana fixing option. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy while ensuring consistent casting of spells. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain momentum through proactive plays and strategic use of resources.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful spells. Key elements include utilizing low-cost creatures like Arid Mesa and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to put pressure on the opponent early in the game. Cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provide additional threats and disruption. Furthermore, the inclusion of cards like Lightning Bolt and Static Prison helps control the board and prevent the opponent from stabilizing. The deck aims to maintain a fast-paced, proactive strategy to secure victories.

The main focus of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt your opponent's game plan with efficient hand disruption spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize, while using removal spells such as Fatal Push and Fell the Profane to deal with any threats they manage to play. The deck aims to control the game by utilizing powerful cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Necrodominance, with the ability to finish off opponents with Soul Spike. The deck also has recursion options with Malakir Rebirth and Boggart Trawler to outvalue opponents in the late game.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game using powerful control spells like Teferi, Time Raveler, Static Prison, and Wrath of the Skies while also utilizing powerful creatures and Planeswalkers such as Wrenn and Six, Omnath, Locus of Creation, and Solitude. The centerpiece of the deck is The One Ring, which provides additional control and advantage. The deck also includes cards like Leyline Binding and Galvanic Discharge to deal with threats efficiently. The mana base is optimized for flexibility and consistency, allowing the deck to stabilize and take over the game.

This deck focuses on aggressively maximizing damage output with a combination of low-cost creatures and powerful spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It includes cards that allow for card advantage through sacrificing creatures or drawing cards, as well as disruption tools such as Thoughtseize. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and efficient aggressive strategy, utilizing the synergy between cards like Gravecrawler and Chthonian Nightmare to maintain pressure. It also includes a mana base that enables consistent casting of spells while supporting the deck's primary goal of fast aggression.

This deck focuses on using a toolbox of creatures to create a powerful combo strategy. By utilizing cards like Urza's Saga and Chord of Calling, the deck can search for specific creatures to control the board and set up a win condition. The deck also includes protection and ramp cards to ensure consistency and resilience. With a mix of utility creatures and combo pieces, the deck aims to outmaneuver opponents and quickly assemble a game-winning combo.

Control the game through a combination of countering spells, controlling the board, and drawing cards. Utilize powerful control cards like Counterspell and Force of Negation to disrupt your opponent's strategy while also generating card advantage with Tune the Narrative and Meticulous Archive. Establish dominance with powerful threats like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and the ultimate control card, The One Ring. Use Teferi, Time Raveler to further control the tempo of the game and protect your key cards. This deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver opponents with a strong control strategy.
